messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planned maintenance Friday 03:30-04:30 UTC for a non-peak interconnect firmware flip + staggered PSU soft-swap in us-west1. We'll do cohorted node reboots and a controlled KV cache reseed to avoid cold-start penalty.
SRE-Bot: Maintenance window created: https://ops.internal/schedules/1763456789 
Priya: Quick q — cohort size? We have ~120 GPUs in that shared pool.
Ben: Suggest 4-6 nodes per cohort, 15m soak between cohorts, with warm backfill nodes kept ready for critical tenants.
Ilya: We should exclude Dedicated pools. Any chance this touches reservation racks?
Alex: Confirmed — Dedicated/reserved racks excluded. Targeting host-shared pool only. We'll set routing policy to prefer eu-central fallback for affected routes.
Priya: Preflight checklist I'll run at 03:00 UTC: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=us-west1-shared -o wide` + `curl -sS /health` against canaries. Canaries: node-a01..a04.
Ben: Rollback criteria: if p95 latency increases >100ms vs baseline for 2 consecutive cohorts OR KV miss-rate >5% sustained 10m, we abort and revert firmware. Runbook: /runbooks/fw-interconnect-swap.md (pinned).
SRE-Bot: Canary probe results (test run): cpu 2.3%, gpu-util steady, kv-hit-rate 93% — all green.
Ilya: Cost note: reseed may generate cross-region egress during priming. Rough estimate: up to +8% egress for the hour -> ~$5k-$7k if full reseed. Recommend throttling reseed concurrency.
Alex: Throttle set to 3 concurrent reseeds and 5MB/s per-node egress cap. Priya will kick first 2 canaries at 03:35 UTC, hold 20m, then proceed with slow roll. Ben monitors dashboards & alerting.
Priya: Added `alertmanager` rule: KV cache miss spike >3% for 5m and p95 increase >80ms for 10m. Also rate-limit cross-region to 50MB/s cluster-wide.
Ben: Customer comms: I'll prep a short support blurb for #support and email owners of Dedicated accounts in us-west1 (even though they're excluded) — transparency. Template: one-line window + expected impact (short retries, possible small latency blips).
Ilya: Post-patch validation: run `kv_cache_prime --region us-west1 --nodes canary` then `perfbench --p95`. I'll own verification and will post results here.
Alex: Final owner split: Priya=canaries & throttle, Ben=alerts & comms, Ilya=validation, Alex=rollback decision. Everyone ack?
Priya: Ack :thumbsup:
Ben: Ack :thumbsup: 
Ilya: Ack
Alex: Prep starts 03:00 UTC. SRE-Bot: Reminder scheduled 02:45 UTC.
